title: Instruction generator
desc: Answer a few questions and it writes your trading instructions. Every round makes a version, and you can go back to any of them.
startHint: The endpoint is only used for these few rounds; your key never leaves your account.
copyFailed: Copy failed, select the text and copy it yourself
empty: The first version shows up here once you answer.
doneHint: Copy the body and paste it into the instruction box on My Trader.
rollbackConfirm: Going back to v{{no}} discards the versions after it. Continue?
noEndpoint: No model endpoint yet — set one up on the AI page.
